nodes.Name: Cover
nodes.DocComment: Cover indicates whether coverage is enabled.

nodes.Name: TestDeps
nodes.DocComment:
TestDeps is an implementation of the testing.testDeps interface,
suitable for passing to [testing.MainStart].

nodes.Name: ImportPath
nodes.DocComment: ImportPath is the import path of the testing binary, set by the generated main function.

nodes.Name: testLog
nodes.DocComment: testLog implements testlog.Interface, logging actions by package os.

nodes.Name: add
nodes.DocComment: add adds the (op, name) pair to the test log.

nodes.Name: SetPanicOnExit0
nodes.DocComment: SetPanicOnExit0 tells the os package whether to panic on os.Exit(0).

nodes.Name: CoverSnapshotFunc
nodes.DocComment:
These variables below are set at runtime (via code in testmain) to point
to the equivalent functions in package internal/coverage/cfile; doing
things this way allows us to have tests import internal/coverage/cfile
only when -cover is in effect (as opposed to importing for all tests).
